title: trailboss --json thread tag

turn.description: The turn, numbered as `thread` numbers them.

label.description: The label now on the turn, on one line, at most 80 characters; null after `--rm`.

removed.description: `--rm` took a label off (false when the turn had none).

description: `thread tag <AGENT:ID> <turn> <label>` labels the turn where a topic starts, shown on it in `thread --tree`; `--rm` takes the label off. Writes only `thread-tags.json` beside the index.
